provenance.qualification: Current source is authoritative; historical dates are first locally evidenced appearances. This artifact grants no authority and is not consumed by runtime code.

conclusion.statement: Stochastic cognition may author isolated candidate files under an active operator-derived lease. Deterministic code exclusively checks the lease and worktree, executes validation, creates and absorbs the commit, derives same-or-narrower continuity, performs handoff, and completes process-image adoption.
conclusion.qualification: ControlPlaneKernel and RuntimeGovernor govern other daemon actions but are not called in this maintenance adoption chain; capability definitions constrain task admission and do not themselves perform runtime admission.

stages.producer: governed signal, work-item intake, Genesis metadata, explicit candidate, or candidate collector
stages.consumer: deterministic candidate selector and lease admission
stages.authority_owner: none; proposal and selection are non-authoritative
stages.persistence: collector receipt JSONL and candidate inbox where configured; selection may remain caller-held
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed for malformed/ineligible candidates; truthful idle when none qualify

stages.producer: deterministic lease admission consuming an explicit sealed operator grant
stages.consumer: implementation, validation, landing, and local absorption machinery
stages.authority_owner: operator grant narrowed into one active task lease
stages.persistence: external maintenance_leases JSON plus tamper-evident task journal
stages.effect_boundary: admits named paths, authority classes, budgets, attempts, validation expectations, and time window
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed on invalid/expired grant, integrity, subset, conflict, concurrency, revocation, scope, or budget failure

stages.producer: bounded local Codex CLI or governed local-model implementation driver
stages.authority_owner: lease and deterministic foreman own filesystem scope; model output is candidate material
stages.persistence: external session/result JSON, worktree, and maintenance journal
stages.effect_boundary: writes only lease-admitted paths in an isolated worktree; no base-ref or resident mutation
stages.failure_posture: bounded_degradation for provider/model unavailability or crash; fail_closed for missing effect authority, scope escape, timeout, malformed output, or lease failure

stages.consumer: commit planner and maintenance task journal
stages.authority_owner: validation controller; candidate assertions are not proof
stages.effect_boundary: runs fixed git diff, pytest, mypy, audit, and expectation-derived argv under sanitized environment and time bounds
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed for failed, missing, malformed, out-of-scope, or timed-out required proof; bounded corrective retry only within lease

stages.consumer: local absorption or remote publication worker
stages.persistence: Git object database plus external immutable plan/result/request/body artifacts and task journal
stages.effect_boundary: creates commit object through an external index; does not move a branch or adopt runtime
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed on authority, evidence, tree, identity, parent, path, or journal mismatch

stages.consumer: task closure and authority-continuity evidence normalization
inputs: active lease with repository_commit and local_repository_base_advance
stages.persistence: canonical Git ref/index/worktree, immutable publication result, task journal
stages.effect_boundary: first authoritative repository-state mutation; explicitly performs no runtime adoption
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed on dirty/ambiguous checkout, expired lease, stale ref, evidence mismatch, persistence or postcondition failure; ref CAS may precede a blocked checkout recovery
unresolved_questions: A crash after ref CAS but before checkout synchronization requires deterministic replay/recovery; it does not roll the ref back automatically.

stages.authority_owner: deterministic continuity controller constrained to same-or-narrower authority
stages.persistence: external immutable generation, manifest, rendered profile, and receipt files
stages.effect_boundary: derives successor maintenance authority; performs no Git/network/runtime adoption
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed on absent/stale/malformed evidence, weak v1 assertions, generation mismatch, widening, partial pair, lock contention, or non-exact repository state

stages.consumer: resident-runtime adoption controller and next wake owner
stages.authority_owner: successor-generation owner; inherited state alone grants nothing
stages.persistence: external configuration/state directories and handoff JSONL
stages.effect_boundary: quiesces predecessor wake owner and starts successor only after optional resident-readiness guard
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed on identity/receipt/lineage/lock mismatch; bounded shutdown/start failures degrade without completing handoff

stages.producer: deterministic resident adoption controller in canonical sentientosd
stages.persistence: digest-chained transition JSONL and immutable predecessor provenance
stages.effect_boundary: quiescence then exact self-exec of configured Python -m sentientosd
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed and terminal on missing/mismatched evidence, timeout, foreign process, unsupported platform, stop marker, or exec failure

stages.consumer: successor handoff guard, health projection, and future resident transitions
stages.persistence: immutable provenance and adoption receipt plus fsynced transition journal; restart durable
stages.effect_boundary: the final resident_adoption_completed phase makes the successor the recorded authoritative resident; exec establishes execution continuity earlier
stages.failure_posture: fail_closed and daemon-terminal on marker, time, provenance, receipt, journal, identity, or persistence mismatch

related_boundaries.ControlPlaneKernel: Canonical sentientosd uses it for lifecycle phase and other maintenance tick effects, but resident adoption methods do not call it.
related_boundaries.RuntimeGovernor: Deterministic governor for restart/repair/control-plane actions, but it is not a prerequisite or caller in the maintenance successor/resident adoption path.
related_boundaries.capability_registry: Declares implemented/deferred/forbidden implications and proof surfaces; it is inventory, not an adoption actuator.
related_boundaries.codex_task_authority_admission: Defines exact deterministic principals/effects for continuity, handoff, and resident adoption; admission metadata is not the persisted runtime transition proof.
related_boundaries.world_state_board: Projects adoption evidence but does not decide this chain.

historical_lineage.event: shallow boundary already contains earlier maintenance machinery
